messages:
Maya R: Quick request — building doing emergency power maintenance Sat morning (6:00–10:00am PT). My home internet will be down. Can someone cover my Sat 6–10am window? I can trade by covering Sun 6am–12pm PT or take Mon 6–10am PT instead. I left a couple of handoff notes below about cache warmup and temporary token rotation. Apologies for the short notice.

Liam: I can take Sat 6–8am PT (first half). Would that help? I have a wedding at 1pm so can't do later.

Maya R: Liam that would be great — even 6–8 helps. If you take 6–8 I can cover Sun 8–12 so we still balance hours.

Chris: I can pick up 8–10am Sat if needed. combine with Liam = full 6–10 covered. ping me the runbook link and I'll review tonight.

Maya R: Awesome, thanks both. Quick runbook highlights: 
```
1) primary dashboard: https://rwd.io/oncall/dash
2) warm caches: run `curl -X POST https://internal/ops/warm --data '{"model":"gptq-16k"}'`
3) ephemeral tokens: if auth fails 401 -> rotate: `kubectl -n infra secrets patch token-secret -p '{"data":{"token":"$(vault read -field=value secret/oncall)"}}'`
4) on-call handoff: update calendar + /ops/schedule
```
If you see sustained 5xxs, escalate to eng-sre and ping me/Chris.

Ritesh: I can be standby on Slack 6–10am in case the warmup script misfires — sitting with laptop. :thumbsup:

Sophia: FYI for the weekend metrics: please watch request latency (p50/p95) and token spend per-min. There's a scheduled dedupe job Sat 03:30 that might spike embeddings traffic later.

Chris: noted on metrics and dedupe job. I'll run the warm cache script at 5:50am PT to pre-warm and post a small log snippet in the thread.

Maya R: Thanks all. @oncall-bot can you add a calendar note that Liam covers Sat 6–8, Chris covers Sat 8–10, Maya covers Sun 8–12, and Ritesh standby?

oncall-bot: Calendar update scheduled — added swap to ops-schedule for 2026-08-10 (Sat) and 2026-08-11 (Sun). Reminder set 1h before each shift.

Liam: Confirmed in my calendar. Thanks Maya — hope the outage is short.

Maya R: Appreciate you all. I'll DM runbook creds to Chris and drop a quick pre-warm confirmation before I lose connectivity.
